items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: He contributed more to the Lunceford style than anybody. We didn't have no style prior to Sy Oliver joining the band.

ctx.x: He contributed more to the Lunceford style than anybody. We didn't have no style prior to Sy Oliver joining the band. But when Sy got there, he made sure you played his arrangements the way he wanted them. And -- which was a great thing. He contributed a great deal to that band.
Did you all have to rehearse? Was his music hard to play?
